name: SuperX
description: SuperX is a Hyperliquid-focused suite with synchronized web and Telegram interfaces: it offers wallet discovery and performance screening (leaderboards, smart-money and vault-oriented views, and detailed trader metrics) together with SuperX Copy Trade flows and a discretionary SuperX Terminal. Official documentation at docs.trysuper.co describes setup, login options, and product behavior for traders who want analytics-driven follow or mirror strategies on Hyperliquid.
